channel.title: KrakenD Blog: Security
channel.description: Posts about Security on the KrakenD blog.

item.title: KrakenD CE 3.0.5, EE 3.0.5 and EE 2.13.15 Update Released
item.description: Patch releases of KrakenD CE and EE that upgrade OpenTelemetry to fix a baggage header vulnerability, plus Kafka async agent, WebSocket and plugin fixes in Enterprise.

item.title: KrakenD CE 3.0.4, EE 3.0.4 and EE 2.13.14 Update Released
item.description: Patch releases of KrakenD CE and EE that upgrade Go to 1.27.4 and CEL, plus quota, AI Gateway and plugin fixes in Enterprise.

item.title: KrakenD CE 3.0.3, EE 3.0.3 and EE 2.13.13 Update Released
item.description: Security patch releases of KrakenD CE and EE that upgrade Go JOSE and x/net, and fix a JWK cache collision in the CE JWT validator.

item.title: CVE-2026-98432: Linux Kernel Flaw Exposing KrakenD on Unpatched Hosts
item.description: A critical Linux kernel bug lets remote attackers target KrakenD on unpatched hosts. Patch the kernel, and disable MPTCP in KrakenD until you do.

item.title: KrakenD CE 3.0.2, EE 3.0.2 and EE 2.13.12 Update Released
item.description: Urgent patch releases of KrakenD CE and EE that distrust compromised eMudhra intermediate CAs, plus OpenAPI, AMQP and AI Gateway fixes.
